"""Raw byte-level transport cases."""
import json, subprocess, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import fast
import ref

def ref_bytes(raw):
    try:
        if len(raw) > 8 * 1024 ** 2:
            return '{"error":"invalid"}'
        text = raw.decode('utf-8')
    except Exception:
        return '{"error":"invalid"}'
    return ref.run_json(text)

CASES = {
    'invalid-utf8': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[1,2,\xff]},',
    'nul-bytes': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[],}\x00',
    'latin1': b'{"version":2,"note":"caf\xe9","sessions":[]}',
    'bom-utf8': b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"version":2,"sessions":[]}',
    'whitespace-only': b'   \n\t ',
    'newlines-in-json': b'{\n "version" : 2,\n "sessions" : [ ]\n}\n',
    'tabs': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[]}\t',
    'unicode-escape': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[],"\\u0078":1}',
    'deep-nesting': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[1]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]}',
    'huge-int': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[],' + b'"x":' + b'9' * 5000 + b'}',
    'exp-int': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[]}e3',
    'over-8mib': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[],' + b'"a":1,' * 200000 + b'"b":2}',
    'just-under': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[],' + b'"a":1,' * 900000 + b'"b":2}',
    'trailing-comma': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[],}',
    'array-root': b'[{"version":2}]',
    'string-root': b'"hello"',
    'true-root': b'true',
    'number-root': b'12',
    'empty-object': b'{}',
    'Infinity': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[],"x":Infinity}',
    '-Infinity': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[-Infinity]}',
    'float-int': b'{"version":2.00,"sessions":[]}',
    'neg-zero': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[],"x":-0.0}',
    'escapes': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[],"x":"\\ud800"}',
    'surrogate-pair': b'{"version":2,"sessions":[],"topology":["leaf\\u002dspine",3,1]}',
}

fails = 0
for name, raw in CASES.items():
    got = fast.candidate_out(raw.decode('utf-8', 'surrogatepass') if False else raw.decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
    exp = ref_bytes(raw)
    # candidate reads bytes so emulate exactly by calling the real entry
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=raw,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    got = p.stdout.decode().strip()
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print('EXITFAIL', name, p.returncode, p.stderr[:200]); fails += 1
        continue
    e = exp.strip()
    try:
        ok = json.loads(e) == json.loads(got)
    except Exception:
        ok = e == got
    if not ok:
        print('MISMATCH %-18s ref=%s cand=%s' % (name, e[:160], got[:160]))
        fails += 1
print('raw failures', fails)
PYEOF
